ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with approximately 20-25% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels distributed as mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white/grey mottling concentrated at the base of the flukes (peduncle connection) and along the leading edges; distinct cluster of high-intensity pixels on the right lobe distal region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with sharp internal angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with high amplitude on the left lobe trailing edge; the right lobe shows more continuous, lower-amplitude irregular peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch extending to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) visible on the ventral surface, particularly concentrated near the trailing edges and lobe tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant jagged irregularities and potential tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating healed trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-contrast, tan-colored protrusions (barnacle clusters) at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
